title: Define canonical engineering decision and research registry
goal: Create strict machine-readable identities, decision classes, states, ownership, affected constraints, product-decision boundaries, and required evidence profiles for autonomous technical decisions.
invariants: engineering decisions never silently resolve product-owned OPEN decisions
claims of best fastest safest or most advanced require dated evidence or representative measurement
research effort is proportional to decision class and stops at evidence saturation
reusable evidence is invalidated when assumptions version constraints or revisit triggers change
security_properties: unknown decision class or missing mandatory evidence fails closed
critical security architecture algorithm and durability decisions require adversarial review
external research evidence is treated as untrusted input and never executable configuration

performance_budget.rationale: research must improve decision quality without becoming a repeated bottleneck
metrics: Class A decisions require no research packet
accepted reusable evidence avoids duplicate research until a revisit trigger fires
research stops at explicit saturation rather than arbitrary source-count inflation

rollback.strategy: revert the E5 lot while retaining verified E0-E4 controls

definition_of_done: decision classes A B and C are closed enums with explicit evidence requirements
product-owned or security-invariant-changing choices cannot be accepted as engineering defaults
decision IDs owners status rationale and affected work units are validated
duplicate or contradictory active decision identities fail closed
